hosted_bundle.creation: Rust coordinator create-new mode0700 before workload
hosted_bundle.source_binding: Git archive HEAD equals actual GITHUB_SHA

cli_diagnostic_policy: Separate fresh prefork master before the 45 cases; never case46 or public CLI qualification. Closed typed observation includes actual bounded CLI exit/signal, master before/after/reap facts, private stream lengths and allowlisted AH codes only. Raw stdout/stderr byte carriers are decoded only into private mode0600 files. Diagnostic failure preserves verified case counts and fails overall completion. Normal lifecycle uses owned pidfd TERM/USR1; forced cleanup fails.
case_diagnostics_policy: Only already validated case IDs/results and fixed Rust assertion or IO-kind labels; unknown errors become operation-failed. Raw stderr, messages, bodies, credentials and paths remain private. Missing unverified outcomes are null. Attach and container exits are independently observed.
cleanup_scope: Only this ledger's verified-engine, label-bound container name and image tag; no volumes, build cache or global content erasure.
diagnostic_policy: Only bounded Rust Edddd codes, source-relative Rust locations and fixed failure labels; no raw messages, snippets, paths outside crates, bodies or credentials.
failure_policy: Nonzero exit, missing/malformed report, hash drift, source mutation, unknown/unreached cases or cleanup failure remain failure. Observed counts are null when the pilot report is unverified, never inferred as zero failures.
execution_policy: No command during root's quiet benchmark window; actual local Linux/WSL or hosted execution requires root allocation under the current measured policy.
